questions.markdown: Design a combinational circuit using 4:16 decoder with active-low outputs to convert BCD code to equivalent XS-3 code.
Design a combinational circuit using programmable logic array (PLA) to implement a full subtractor.

Use Boolean algebra to derive the simplest sum-of-products expression for the function

$$
f = x\overline{y}z + wyz + w\overline{x}z.
$$

 

Implement the simplified function using only NAND gates.
Design a Moore-type circuit using D flip-flops, with one input and one output to detect the occurrences of the bit pattern 110 in a sequential pulse train.
Implement the function $f(w, x, y, z) = \sum m (0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 14)$ using 2-level multiplexer structure comprising of two 4:1 MUXs and one 2:1 MUX.
Using the characteristic equations and excitation table, realize an SR flip-flop using a D flip-flop.
Design a hazard-free mod-16 asynchronous edge counter by synthesizing a mod-8 pulse counter.
Using negative edge triggered T flipflops, design mod 14 ripple counter. Also draw the timing diagram.
Analyze the behavior of a SR flip-flop as an asynchronous sequential circuit using the Moore model. Derive the state transition table, flow table and state diagram accordingly.
Design a synchronous Mod-12 counter using JK flipflops. Draw the timing diagram for the same.
